text:
nina: Kicking off a targeted v2 flip for /api/embeddings to address latency tail with new quant kernels. rolling in controlled slices; will watch client regression signals. docs: https://confluence.redwood.ai/rls/emb-v2-cutover

pablo: thanks. small ask: pinlist for enterprise tenants who requested delayed v2? need to ensure they stay on v1.

nina: pinlist loaded from release config: `enterprise_hold.csv`. deploybot should honor it during ramp.

deploy-bot: Canary job 3567890123 started. slices: 5% -> 20% -> 50% over 30m. enterprise_hold.csv loaded (42 tenants). Auto-rollback hooks enabled.

zhi: ops eyes: what are our rollback triggers for embeddings? token-embedding-drift and 5xx thresholds?

nina: explicit criteria: 5xx > 0.5% for 15m OR embedding-cosine-drift > 0.03 aggregated OR p99 latency +50% baseline. Manual approval required to fully rollback.

ops-sre: taking handoff. assigning @zhi as operator for 45m. enabling logging hook for embedding-diff samples.

pablo: seeing a small number of enterprise tenants (t-402, t-811) appearing on v2 in slice 1. I think the pinlist didn't map due to a tenant-id normalization bug.

deploy-bot: Alert: tenant normalization mismatch detected for 2 entries. Recommended command: `deploybot pin --add t-402 --route /api/embeddings`

zhi: applied fixes: normalized tenant keys and applied immediate pins for t-402 and t-811. shim confirmed.

pablo: after pin apply, their traffic is back to v1. thanks. note: we'll run a small migration script to reconcile pinlist formats post-cutover.

nina: observed p99 latency +12% on slice-3 but stable error rates. embedding drift samples show rare cosine delta spikes from a single model shard. collecting samples for eval.

ops-sre: traced a thread-lock in shard 7 during heavy batching windows causing backlog and transient latency spikes. restarted the worker; backlog cleared. no customer impact reported.

nina: decision: continue ramp but exclude shard 7 from next slice until we patch the locking issue. applying shard exclude flag.

deploy-bot: Shard exclude applied: shard-7 removed from rotation for job 3567890123. Next slice will skip shard-7.

pablo: reminder: ops to coordinate with SDK team if embedding vectors change length or dtype; that would break clients. any model-level schema changes?

nina: no vector shape/schema change in this cut; only kernel/quant changes. still, tag SDK leads for awareness. @alex-mobile fyi.

alex-mobile: acknowledged. we'll add a quick compatibility smoke to the mobile SDK CI that checks vector dims on receive. will report back within 2 hours.

ops-sre: operator commands log:
```
# view pinlist
deploybot pinlist --route /api/embeddings
# apply tenant pin
deploybot pin --add t-402 --route /api/embeddings
# exclude shard
deploybot shard-exclude --job 3567890123 --shard 7
```

zhi: monitoring now: 5xx = 0.02%, embedding drift avg = 0.005, p99 latency +10ms. All within thresholds.

nina: keeping shard-7 excluded until patch. keep enterprise pins until post-cutover audit. closing window unless alerts surface. please update release notes with pinlist caveats.

deploy-bot: Canary job 3567890123 reached 50% slices. No auto-rollback triggered. Job recorded.

ops-sre: handback noted to @zhi for 2h deep-dive on shard lock root cause. will post closure when shard reintroduced.

pablo: I'll follow up on pinlist normalization PR after the window. thanks team.

nina: great work. final owners: @zhi (investigation), @alex-mobile (SDK check), @pablo (pinlist reconciles). closing unless alerts fire. :white_check_mark:
